def: a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest

occurrences.text: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
